study_identification_part.si_4_title: Delineating the Heterogeneity of Alzheimer's Disease and Mild Cognitive Impairment Using Normative Models of Dynamic Brain Functional Networks

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Dataset 1: Cam-CAN; Dataset 2: MCAD; Dataset 3: ADNI.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Dataset 1... was obtained from the Cambridge Centre for Aging and Neuroscience repository (Cam-CAN...)"; "Dataset 2 comprised... from the MCAD (Multicenter Alzheimer Disease Imaging Consortium) dataset."; "Dataset 3 included... from the ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative) database"

answer.MCAD: apply normative model to estimate deviations and identify AD/MCI subtypes

answer.ADNI: independent dataset to investigate longitudinal changes in MCI (replication/validation)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Cam-CAN used to build the normative model; MCAD used for deviation estimation and subtype identification; ADNI used for longitudinal replication/validation in MCI.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Dataset 1... was used in this work to build a normative model"; "For dataset 2, the a-FCS and f-FCS deviation values were estimated... Patient subtypes were identified"; "Dataset 3... was used to investigate longitudinal changes in MCI"

model-1.model-name: dynamic functional connectome normative model (34 dFC features)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Normative model built using Cam-CAN healthy participants (NC n=644); model trained on dataset 1 after cross-validation.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "Dataset 1, which included 644 healthy individuals, was used in this work to build a normative model"; "NC, n = 644"; "Finally, the normative model was trained based on dataset 1"

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age reported for Cam-CAN NCs in Table 1 (mean and SD, years).
